name: Marquee
purpose: Present continuous decorative motion while retaining one accessible original track.
useWhen: A logo, text or passive media strip benefits from continuous motion.

avoidWhen.condition: Content includes arbitrary interactive stateful widgets.

composition: Compose Root, Viewport, Content and Item. Supply Content renderReplica explicitly with pure, passive, ID-free visual content.
Use a persistent external pause button for indefinite motion. RootProvider accepts useMarquee for external controls.
Constrain vertical motion with Frame blockSize. Optional Edge paint must match the owning surface.

Use recognizable, passive artwork for logo strips and reserve image dimensions before loading. Keep ordinary image galleries straight; intentional artwork transforms belong to a separate outer container, never Content’s motion transform.

rules.statement: Use autoFill for short tracks. Responsive spacing accepts initial/sm/md/lg/xl. PropsProvider supplies spacing/unstyled defaults, not motion state. Unstyled parts need replacement layout/motion CSS or use Atom.
Never blindly clone interactive or stateful children. Unsafe or absent replicas produce stationary originals; inert and aria-hidden do not make callback side effects safe.
Respect reduced motion and focus-to-static behavior. User pause is independent of hover and completion; restart does not discard requested pause.
Use the shared spacing contract: numeric factors multiply by four pixels, legacy string spacing tokens retain their mapping. Default numeric 4 is 16px.
Load styles.css or core.css plus marquee.css and CSS for all composed components.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using duration and speed as competing authorities.
commonMistakes.correction: Set speed in pixels per second; measured geometry determines duration.
Provide a named persistent button usable by keyboard and touch.

validation: Check actual transforms and pairwise track gaps through pause/resume, finite callbacks, direction/RTL, focus visibility, replica safety, reduced motion, hidden content, narrow width and edge paint. Test testimonials with passive star artwork and avatar image replicas, not repeated loading controllers.
